install.description: Installs ufw and fail2ban, sets the default policies, allows the SSH port, enables ufw and activates the sshd jail. No-op when already in place.
install.title: Install firewall

uninstall.description: Disables ufw, removes the fail2ban jail drop-in and purges both packages. No-op when not installed.
uninstall.title: Uninstall firewall

update.description: Upgrades ufw and fail2ban and re-asserts the module's rules. No-op when current.
update.title: Update firewall

verify.description: Read-only check that ufw is active with the SSH port allowed and the fail2ban sshd jail is running. Exits non-zero when it is not.
verify.title: Verify firewall

description: Manages the host firewall with ufw (default deny in, allow out, allow the SSH port) and fail2ban with an sshd jail in aggressive mode. Uninstall disables ufw and purges both. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: firewall
title: Firewall
